newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia stocks end higher with Bavaria in demand.
newsitem.headline: Colombia stocks end higher with Bavaria in demand.

text.p: Colombian stocks closed up in active trading dominated by foreign demand for shares of Bavaria, the country's leading brewer.

Bogota's IBB price index finished ahead 0.64 percent to 1,199.57 on turnover of 11 billion pesos. Medellin's IBOMED general price index climbed 0.64 percent to 18,255.37 on turnover of 6.4 billion pesos.
Bavaria jumped 3.3 percent to 8,500 in Bogota on trading of shares worth 2.8 billion peso volume. It was up 3.09 percent to 8,499 in Medellin on turnover of 1.5 billion pesos.
